about: Ramp marks for the Avenues climb and the Roadmap to court (0.7.1, 7 Nov 2026). 'fee': replies on the ramps that quote a fee or will not disclose until paid, read in each reply's own words (quoted text cut), that the hand-kept fee list did not already mark; they show the £ symbol only, no amounts. 'chestnut': replies on the ramps with a That Old Chestnut entry, by the same match rules as the dartboard cells (chestnuts.json): an old-chestnut entry whose evidence id (EV-...) the reply carries, or a tactic or silence entry whose dated reply ('back_date') is this reply, in the same institution and ring. Keys are case-mail archive ids. Outbound mail is not drawn on the ramps and is not listed here.
